items.quote: Direct reports said that Zeko Raveth took ownership of drafting legislative amendments for the new act and steered it to completion.
Zeko Raveth managed mapping interdependencies across agencies for his unit.
Zeko Raveth handled emergency coordination during the flood response competently within his team.
Several respondents noted that Zeko Raveth managed reaching a deal with the contractor after weeks of back-and-forth for his unit.
Several respondents noted that Zeko took ownership of the digital redesign of the permit system and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Zeko Raveth drove the five-year strategic plan for the division for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Zeko headed accountability arrangements for public funds, setting priorities for several teams.
Peers observed that Zeko was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of engagement with industry stakeholders.
Direct reports said that Zeko drove efforts that helped three direct reports earn promotion for the whole division.
Direct reports said that Zeko Raveth championed evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He drove teamwork across departments on the annual review for the whole division.
